verdict.rationale: Stripe Invoicing documents billing a customer in a currency other than their default (multi-currency customers), which covers local-currency invoicing. It also supports a reusable product/price catalog, but nothing in the evidence shows per-currency price points on a single price. Reporting evidence is limited to CSV export and an organization-wide invoice list, with no mention of converting to or consolidating in a home currency. Missing for 10: per-currency price points on products/prices, consolidated reporting converted into home currency, independent corroboration.
